name: Mushroom Testing Facility
desc:
You are humanity's last hope. Test on, discover, and kill the variety of parasites avaliable.

Found a rulebreaker? Say "/votekick {player}" to initiate a Votekick against them! 60% of the server must vote yes for it to proceed.

This game has been discontinued and will not receive updates or maintenance going forward. Check out the sequel instead: https://www.roblox.com/games/118336221975564/Myriad-Laboratories

HEAVILY inspired by antscientist's Parasite Testing and various Innovation Inc games.
